$comment: Documented exceptions for scripts/check-design-utilities.mjs (Plan 217). Each entry names a file, the class or declaration as the guard prints it, and the reason no token owns it. An entry that matches nothing fails the check. A reason that starts with "Open (Plan 217)" is a design value with no token yet, waiting on an owner decision; the others are geometry or system behaviour.

allow.reason: The indicator's offset is the progress value itself (translateX(-(100 - value)%)): a runtime measurement, not a design value.
Open (Plan 217): the selected value truncates to one line. A behaviour count; needs a token only if the line count is meant to change.
Open (Plan 217): blur behind the dialog overlay. Tailwind's sm is 8px; there is no token and no Figma background blur yet.
Open (Plan 217): blur behind the sheet overlay (see dialog.tsx).
Flips the chevron when the item opens: orientation geometry, not a design value.
Flips the chevron when the menu opens (see accordion.tsx).
Turns the arrow's square into a diamond: shape geometry, not a design value.
Turns the handle grip upright in a vertical group: orientation geometry, not a design value.
prefers-reduced-motion: cuts every animation to an instant so Radix still gets animationend. A system accessibility behaviour, not a designer-owned value.
One full turn of the loading spinner: the geometry of a rotation, not a design value. Its time and curve are the button.spinner tokens.
